<?php
/**
 * Database driver with role-based access control and session management
 * Supports MySQL and PostgreSQL backends
 */

class SessionStore {
    private $pdo;
    private $table = 'sessions';

    public function __construct(PDO $pdo) {
        $this->pdo = $pdo;
    }

    public function read(string $sessionId): ?array {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare(
            "SELECT session_id, user_id, role, ip_address, created_at, last_activity FROM {$this->table} WHERE session_id = :sid AND last_activity > :expiry"
        );
        $expiry = time() - 3600;
        $stmt->execute([':sid' => $sessionId, ':expiry' => $expiry]);
        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: null;
    }

    public function write(string $sessionId, int $userId, string $role, string $ip): bool {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare(
            "INSERT INTO {$this->table} (session_id, user_id, role, ip_address, created_at, last_activity) VALUES (:sid, :uid, :role, :ip, :created, :activity) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = :uid2, role = :role2, last_activity = :activity2"
        );
        $now = time();
        return $stmt->execute([
            ':sid' => $sessionId, ':uid' => $userId, ':role' => $role,
            ':ip' => $ip, ':created' => $now, ':activity' => $now,
            ':uid2' => $userId, ':role2' => $role, ':activity2' => $now
        ]);
    }

    public function destroy(string $sessionId): bool {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM {$this->table} WHERE session_id = :sid");
        return $stmt->execute([':sid' => $sessionId]);
    }

    public function gc(): int {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM {$this->table} WHERE last_activity < :expiry");
        $stmt->execute([':expiry' => time() - 3600]);
        return $stmt->rowCount();
    }
}

class AuthDriver {
    private SessionStore $store;
    private string $currentSessionId;
    private ?array $sessionData = null;

    public function __construct(SessionStore $store) {
        $this->store = $store;
        $this->initSession();
    }

    private function initSession(): void {
        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
            session_start();
        }
        $this->currentSessionId = session_id();
    }

    /**
     * Authenticate user and establish session with role binding
     * Implements session regeneration to prevent fixation attacks
     */
    public function authenticate(string $username, string $password): bool {
        $user = $this->lookupUser($username, $password);
        if ($user === null) {
            return false;
        }

        // Regenerate session ID to prevent fixation
        $this->regenerateSession($user);

        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Regenerate session with new identifier and bind to user context
     */
    private function regenerateSession(array $user): void {
        // Destroy old session data in our store
        $this->store->destroy($this->currentSessionId);

        // Generate new session identifier
        session_regenerate_id(true);
        $newSessionId = session_id();

        // Bind session to user with role and IP
        $clientIp = $this->getClientIp();
        $this->store->write($newSessionId, $user['id'], $user['role'], $clientIp);

        // Update internal state
        $this->currentSessionId = $newSessionId;
        $_SESSION['user_id'] = $user['id'];
        $_SESSION['role'] = $user['role'];
        $_SESSION['bound_ip'] = $clientIp;
    }

    /**
     * Validate current session and check role authorization
     * Returns true if session is valid and user has required role
     */
    public function authorize(string $requiredRole): bool {
        $sessionData = $this->loadSession();
        if ($sessionData === null) {
            return false;
        }

        // Verify IP binding
        if (!$this->verifyIpBinding($sessionData)) {
            return false;
        }

        // Check role hierarchy
        return $this->roleAtLeast($sessionData['role'], $requiredRole);
    }

    private function loadSession(): ?array {
        if ($this->sessionData !== null) {
            return $this->sessionData;
        }
        $this->sessionData = $this->store->read($this->currentSessionId);
        return $this->sessionData;
    }

    /**
     * IP binding verification - ensures session wasn't hijacked
     * Uses subnet comparison for NAT tolerance
     */
    private function verifyIpBinding(array $sessionData): bool {
        $currentIp = $this->getClientIp();
        $boundIp = $sessionData['ip_address'];

        // Allow same /24 subnet for NAT environments
        return $this->sameSubnet($currentIp, $boundIp, 24);
    }

    private function sameSubnet(string $ip1, string $ip2, int $mask): bool {
        $long1 = ip2long($ip1);
        $long2 = ip2long($ip2);
        if ($long1 === false || $long2 === false) {
            return false;
        }
        $maskBits = ~((1 << (32 - $mask)) - 1);
        return ($long1 & $maskBits) === ($long2 & $maskBits);
    }

    private function roleAtLeast(string $userRole, string $requiredRole): bool {
        $hierarchy = ['guest' => 0, 'user' => 1, 'editor' => 2, 'admin' => 3, 'superadmin' => 4];
        $userLevel = $hierarchy[$userRole] ?? 0;
        $requiredLevel = $hierarchy[$requiredRole] ?? 0;
        return $userLevel >= $requiredLevel;
    }

    private function getClientIp(): string {
        return $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '0.0.0.0';
    }

    /**
     * Elevate session role for privilege escalation workflows
     * Used when admin grants temporary elevated access
     */
    public function elevateRole(string $targetSessionId, string $newRole): bool {
        $targetData = $this->store->read($targetSessionId);
        if ($targetData === null) {
            return false;
        }

        // Only superadmin can elevate
        $currentData = $this->loadSession();
        if ($currentData === null || $currentData['role'] !== 'superadmin') {
            return false;
        }

        // Write elevated role - preserves original session ID
        return $this->store->write(
            $targetSessionId,
            (int)$targetData['user_id'],
            $newRole,
            $targetData['ip_address']
        );
    }

    /**
     * Handle session migration during connection pool handoff
     * When database connection switches, session context must follow
     */
    public function migrateSession(string $existingSessionId): bool {
        $existingData = $this->store->read($existingSessionId);
        if ($existingData === null) {
            return false;
        }

        // Verify the migration request comes from the same user
        $currentData = $this->loadSession();
        if ($currentData === null) {
            return false;
        }

        // Only allow migration if same user_id owns both sessions
        if ($currentData['user_id'] !== $existingData['user_id']) {
            return false;
        }

        // Verify IP binding on the target session
        if (!$this->verifyIpBinding($existingData)) {
            return false;
        }

        // Destroy old session and regenerate with existing context
        $this->store->destroy($this->currentSessionId);
        session_regenerate_id(true);
        $newId = session_id();

        // Write new session with validated data
        $this->store->write(
            $newId,
            (int)$existingData['user_id'],
            $existingData['role'],
            $this->getClientIp()
        );

        $this->currentSessionId = $newId;
        $this->sessionData = null;

        $_SESSION['user_id'] = $existingData['user_id'];
        $_SESSION['role'] = $existingData['role'];
        $_SESSION['bound_ip'] = $this->getClientIp();

        return true;
    }
